name: China Tobacco International (HK) Company Limited
summary: China Tobacco International (HK) Company Limited (CTIHK) trades tobacco products internationally, founded in 2004 and headquartered in Kowloon, Hong Kong, as a subsidiary of China Tobacco International Group Limited. It has four units: tobacco leaf export, tobacco leaf import into mainland China, cigarette export to duty-free retailers and wholesalers, and new tobacco product export. It operates in China, Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Singapore, Brazil and other markets.
